entry.summary: Helen Brown (Ngāi Tahu) is a senior researcher in the Ngāi Tahu Archive Team at Te Rūnanga o Ngāi Tahu. Helen has extensive experience in the Galleries, Libraries, Archives and Museums (GLAM) sector. Helen leads the award-winning Tāngata Ngāi Tahu biographies project that explores tribal history through the lens of biography. Volume one of Tāngata Ngāi Tahu: People of Ngāi Tahu (with Takerei Norton, Bridget Williams Books) was winner of the 2018 New Zealand Heritage Nonfiction Book Award.
